observations: A large flat yellow rectangle occupies the upper two-thirds of the image against a black field; the bottom edge of the rectangle is ragged where black silhouetted rounded forms crowd beneath it.
Eight or nine black silhouetted rounded forms line the lower edge, each marked with small yellow crossed lines near the top of each form; one smaller form sits lower between two taller ones.
A row of loose vertical zigzag lines in black spans the full width of the yellow area just above the silhouetted forms; a small yellow leaf-like mark appears in the lower-left black corner.
reading: A flat yellow field presses down on a crowd of black shapes that push back from below. The zigzag lines between them read as noise, heat, or pressure — something unresolved passing between the two zones. The crossed marks on each rounded form give the group a shared, slightly unsettling sameness. The large empty yellow above offers no relief, only exposure.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work stands apart from its title neighbors: nnxyz nnotb #118 fills its frame with dense layered marks and many colors, while nnxyz nnotb #120 uses a teal field with a single central figure. Here the composition strips to two colors and a crowd.

connections.reason: Both works use a saturated yellow field as the dominant background and place rounded head-like forms against it — though nnxyz nifty faces #81 fills its single form with dense multicolor lines while #119 reduces its crowd to flat black silhouettes.
nnxyz nnotb #120 shares the high-contrast two-tone approach — a flat color field against black — but places one isolated figure centered in teal rather than a compressed crowd at the base of yellow.

lookingQuestion: What does the size of the empty yellow area above the figures do to how you read the zigzag lines between them?
ambiguities: The small leaf-like mark in the lower-left corner may be a recurring signature element; its function here is not confirmed by supplied metadata.

The crossed marks on the silhouetted forms vary slightly in size and style — whether this variation is consistent across the group or distinguishes specific forms is difficult to resolve at image resolution.
